reason: An automation-focused WeChat content production pipeline supporting structured drafting, image generation, OCR acceptance checks, logging, and draft-box synchronization.

summaries.zh: 用于微信公众号内容生产的工作流插件，支持结构化写作、配图生成、图片文字 OCR 验收、日志记录和草稿箱同步。
summaries.en: A workflow plugin for WeChat Official Account content production with structured drafting, image generation, OCR text checks, logging, and draft-box synchronization.

capabilities: Generates content and image prompts for WeChat Official Account posts
Uses external image-generation endpoints when configured with user-provided credentials
Performs OCR-based verification of text in images
Synchronizes drafts through an internal WeChat web API
